**Finding: compliant** (WARRANTY — Performance warranty and duration)

Section 12 meets the preferred position: an express conformance-to-Specifications warranty running for the acceptance period plus one year from the Maintenance Commencement Date, and continuing while the Software stays under Maintenance Services. Remedies are real — correction during acceptance testing (§6(b)), no-charge best-efforts repair under the Software Repair Service, and full return of amounts paid if Sparkling rejects (§7–§8). Critically, there is no "AS IS" clause or disclaimer of implied/other warranties anywhere in the Agreement, so the express warranty is not swallowed, and §15 preserves recovery of direct damages.

Noted but not flagged: no express professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, no compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranty, and the repair obligation is a "best efforts" standard with chargeable-cause carve-outs. These are sub-elements short of preferred wording, not material failures, so no redline was proposed.
